from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a legal party in the document."""
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the party")
    role: str = Field(description="The role of the party, e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，申请人")

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific court fee mentioned in the document."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary amount of the fee")
    currency: str = Field(default="元", description="The currency unit")
    description: str = Field(description="Description of the fee, e.g., 二审案件受理费")
    bearer: str = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g., 上诉人，李某 1")
    stage: str | None = Field(description="Case stage associated with the fee, e.g., 一审，二审")

class CaseNumber(BaseModel):
    """Represents a case number referenced in the document."""
    number: str = Field(description="The full case number, e.g., （2023）辽 0323 民初 4672 号")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court issuing the case number")
    stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage, e.g., 一审，二审，再审，执行")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judicial document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document identifier/title, e.g., 判决文书 1")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of judgment, e.g., 民事，行政，执行")
    court: str | None = Field(description="The court or government body issuing the judgment")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="The core ruling outcome, e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[FeeRecord] = Field(description="List of fee records including amounts and bearers")
    case_numbers: list[CaseNumber] = Field(description="List of case numbers referenced in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for parsed documents."""
    documents: list[Document] = Field(description="A list of extracted document instances")
